raw_definitions: Definisi : vt ( usu pass. ) 1. destine ( to fail etc ) ditakdirkan (+ approp v ): the expedition was ~ed to failure, ekspedisi itu ditakdirkan gagal; 2. certain ( to be destroyed etc ) pasti (akan + approp v ): the beautiful countryside is ~ed because of the tourist trade, desa yg cantik itu pasti akan tercemar krn industri pelancongan. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : n 1. death, ajal, maut: as the waves crashed about the boat, she knew that she would meet her ~ in the stormy sea, apabila gelombang menghempas bot itu, dia tahu bahawa dia akan menemui ajalnya dlm laut yg bergelora itu; 2. terrible fate, nasib /celaka, malang/, malapetaka: the seers who spoke of the approaching ~, peramal yg mengatakan nasib malang yg hampir tiba; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
